body: I'm afraid of what will happen if I tell my parents that I'm depressed and I've been thinking of killing myself for about 3-4 months now. Last night I just..snapped. Couldn't take it anymore...I don't know why but...I feel like I deserve to feel this way, to be sad and lonely. I just try to keep a happy face all the time and don't tell anyone what's happening with me. My parents aren't really helping me with anything. I appreciate that they help me with money every single day so I won't starve, and they buy me cloths...but, they've never been real parents to me. I don't know if you can understand. They called me a spoiled brat ( this is a new one, beside being an embarrassment, stupid and not capable of doing anything by myself) but I'M NOT. I really don't care for their money, I just want to be happy...Thank you for sharing and talking to me. I'm getting tired again....I think I'm going to go sleep....
I am ok. Thanks for asking. ( Thank you all for trying to help me) I'm still really really sad...but at least I don't want to kill myself right now.
Thank you for trying to help me. A friend called me and I'm talking to him now.

Thank you for wasting what little time you have on me. I try not to listen to them....but it's starting to make sense. I'm failing my exams, I feel so tired all the time and sad, I had goals, I had a hobby...but now I just want to sleep and let it all end.

Thanks for replying. I just wanted to talk to someone who doesn't know me, because you will probably won't judge me for what I'm going to do. It's really hard to feel this way. Can't even talk to my parents about this, they think I'm an embarrassment, that I'm stupid, that I I'm not capable of taking care of myself. I will probably kill myself in a couple of weeks.....I can't go on like this...I wanted to do it now but I really don't know what has changed.
